items.hypothesis: P3 control, variable = ending (surprise-wake quiz in the final third vs V20-06's plain payoff): expected higher watched-full % and higher average watch time.
items.caption:
POV: you wake right before the alarm.
In a small 1999 study (15 people, in a lab), those told they would be woken at 6 a.m. showed a rise in the hormone ACTH about an hour earlier; those who expected 9 a.m. and were woken at 6 did not. It measured hormones, not why you wake early: one small study.
